statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity.
The patient has diagnoses R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered.
